name: EES: a missing exit is found and its days listed

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2024-06-14&fresh=1 (pins today and clears saved trips)
Click the add trip button (data-testid=trip-add), enter entry 2024-06-01 (data-testid=trip-entry) and exit 2024-06-10 (data-testid=trip-exit), and click save (data-testid=trip-save)
Enter 14 in the EES days used field (data-testid=ees-days-used), enter '2024-06-01' in the EES records field (data-testid=ees-records), and click compare (data-testid=ees-compare)
The findings list (data-testid=ees-codes) has data-codes containing 'likely-missing-exit'
The days that differ (data-testid=ees-differences) show one range (data-testid=ees-difference) with data-from 2024-06-11 and data-to 2024-06-14, marked 'EES only'
